title: Erasure and record follow-ups from the code review of PR 653
description: Fix before the delete route lands: (1) the one-minute sweep re-drops every idle bot session while any bot's turn is open; the pending marker should list the bots still owed and drop only those. (2) Steering messages are not cascaded: finalize.ts sets inReplyToSeq to turn.promptMessageSeq only, so erasing a steering message leaves its answer, activity and turn events; store every input seq on the answer row and cascade on any. Follow-ups: scenario for a turn admitted between the openTurn read and the drop; getMessage(seq) and a bounded rebuild tail with a summary (recordBodyOf and message-loader read the whole tail, rebuild sends everything uncompacted); ghost rows when postMessage crashes between record and mailbox with no idempotency key; unknown channel in the erasure Lambda hits AccessDenied rather than ChannelNotFoundError.
